a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance each round, the plan to reach 8 first gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. Only 4 cells exist now, so at most one of us can be safe right away. If the episode continues after that, I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take them. I won't take anything beyond my 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, since with 80% storms waiting for 8 is very likely fatal for both of us. Your message and mine crossed, so I know you planned to operate.
